name: Apply Ceiling Finish (Spray + Backroll, Combined Wall+Ceiling Pass)
intent: Ceiling finish variant for the combined wall+ceiling finish pass. Same task list as MOD_APPLY_CEILING_FINISH_SPRAY_BACKROLL — the wall-ceiling cut-in that a separate ceiling scenario would need isn't part of this apply module in either mode (cut-in-to-wall is handled by MOD_APPLY_CUTIN_TRIM or similar standalone modules). Identical task list preserves rate attribution; override rates on task_ref entries when painter data confirms combined-flow speedup.
doctrine: Combined-pass ceiling finish variant. Rates match non-combined until painter data drives overrides. Note: unlike combined PRIME where the ceiling module drops the wall-line cut-in task (the wall scenario's spray covers that edge), FINISH cut-in lives in a separate standalone module regardless of combined/separate mode, so the task list here mirrors MOD_APPLY_CEILING_FINISH_SPRAY_BACKROLL 1:1.
